shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着一张空白许可证
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a blank permit form drawn on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 作业许可十问，答完马上揭晓！
overlay: 作业许可十问：何时办、谁检查、何时停

shots.scene: 四个图标：许可证、放大镜、火焰、暂停键
shots.prompt_en: A row of four icons: a blank permit form, a magnifier, a flame and a pause button. No people.
shots.narration: 为什么办，谁检查，什么时候停。

shots.scene: 老李在实验楼走廊比划一个要焊的金属支架
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory building corridor, the facility engineer holds up a metal bracket and points at the wall where it will be fixed.
shots.narration: 走廊要焊一个支架，就在实验室旁边。

shots.scene: 阿杰说：焊几下而已
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and makes a quick small gesture with two fingers.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：焊几下而已，要这么麻烦？

shots.scene: 小研举起空白的动火许可证
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a blank permit form with a flame icon on it.
shots.narration: 小研说：动火就得先办许可。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿起马克笔，在白板上写下数字 1
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot picks up a marker and draws a big number one on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们一题一题来看。

shots.section_title: 边听边测：题后即给答案
shots.scene: 白板上一道题，下面立刻出现对勾
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with a blank question box; a green checkmark appears right below it. No people.
shots.narration: 每题先想一想，答案马上公布。
overlay: 边听边测：题后即给答案

shots.section_title: 边听边测：题后即给答案
shots.scene: 阿杰在纸上记分
shots.prompt_en: The young male student keeps score on a blank sheet with tally marks.
shots.narration: 答对一题，记一分。

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 三个图标：限制区门、安全帽、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a door with a restricted area pictogram, a hard hat and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：为什么要用作业许可？
overlay: 为什么用作业许可制度

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 三个图标被一个大括号圈在一起
shots.prompt_en: The three icons are grouped together by a big green bracket with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 管住限制区作业，安全干活防意外。

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 老李在许可证上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer ticks items on a blank permit form one by one.
shots.narration: 还能把控制措施真正落实。

shots.section_title: 为什么用作业许可制度
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起三根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers and smiles.
shots.narration: 答案是：以上都是。

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 许可证上一排勾选框，下面一条粗线
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with a column of checkboxes above a thick floor line. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：许可证上写的安全内容？
overlay: 许可证写的是最低措施

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 通用清单图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A generic long checklist icon is crossed out with a red X next to a short tailored checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 控制风险的最低措施，不是通用清单。

shots.section_title: 许可证写的是最低措施
shots.scene: 王老师翻开国内法规手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank law handbook on a desk.
shots.narration: 依据是国内法规和本单位制度。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：射线、火焰、扫帚、管道压力表
shots.prompt_en: Four icon cards: a radiation trefoil, a flame, a broom and a pipe with a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪个是低风险作业？

shots.scene: 扫帚卡片被圈出，其余三张亮红灯
shots.prompt_en: The broom card is circled in green; the other three cards glow with red warning lights. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁清扫；射线、动火、试压都不是。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡住一个碰撞图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield blocks a collision icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：许可制度的主要目标？

shots.scene: 文件夹、审核章、调查放大镜图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a file folder, an audit stamp and an investigation magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了存档、审核或事后调查。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 答案是防止事故。

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 老周拿着动火许可证走到焊接点
shots.prompt_en: The older man carries a blank permit form with a flame icon to the welding spot in the corridor.
shots.narration: 第五题：签发动火许可前查什么？
overlay: 签发动火许可前查三样

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 老周核对老李的签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks the signature box on the form held by the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 一查接收人有没有授权签字。

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 灭火器到位，周围易燃物已清走
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher stands ready; the area around the welding spot has been cleared of boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 二查许可证上的措施有没有落实。

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查三样
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员拿着灭火器站好
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands beside the welding spot holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 三查称职的监火人有没有到位。

shots.scene: 老周和老李在走廊里边看边谈
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer walk along the corridor, looking and talking.
shots.narration: 第六题：联合检查讨论什么？

shots.scene: 虚线框出焊接范围，旁边是焊机图标
shots.prompt_en: A dashed box marks the welding area on a wall, with a welding machine icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 干到哪里，用什么设备。

shots.scene: 老周指向隔壁实验室门上的易燃品标志
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a flammable warning sign on the neighboring laboratory door.
shots.narration: 还有会影响安全的特殊条件。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：车间、空地、实验室、泵和火焰
shots.prompt_en: Four icon cards: a workshop, an open yard, a laboratory flask and a pump with a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：哪个算限制区？

shots.scene: 泵和火焰那张卡被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The pump card with the flame pictogram is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答案是易燃物料泵区。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验楼门口摇头指着实验室
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes her head gently and points at a laboratory door.
shots.narration: 但在学校，实验室施工也要报批。

shots.scene: 老周拿着绿色低风险标签
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a green low-risk tag beside a task card.
shots.narration: 第八题：何时可以不办许可？

shots.scene: 钟表和钱币图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon and a coin icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 低风险才行；时间短、花钱少不算。

shots.scene: 许可证被盖上暂停章
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form receives a large red pause stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：许可证什么时候取消？

shots.scene: 三个图标：违规手势、警报灯、雷雨云
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a hand ignoring a rule card, a flashing alarm light and a thunderstorm cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 不守条件、遇紧急情况、天气恶劣。

shots.scene: 老李停下焊机，退到安全处
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the welding machine and steps back to a safe spot.
shots.narration: 取消就停工，重新确认才能再干。

shots.scene: 老周和老李一起站在焊接点
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer stand together at the welding spot.
shots.narration: 第十题：签发前谁做联合检查？

shots.scene: 两人握手，许可证上签两个名
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer shake hands above a blank permit form that shows two signed boxes.
shots.narration: 签发人和接收人，一起到现场。

shots.scene: 实验室门口贴着电离辐射标志，里面是一台仪器
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door with an ionizing radiation warning sign; inside, a boxy analytical instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 学校也有射线装置。

shots.scene: 老李在门口看到辐射标志停步，王老师递上审批单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops at the radiation sign while the safety administrator hands him a blank approval form.
shots.narration: 在旁边维修，先报审批、先停机。

shots.scene: 地上拉起警戒线
shots.prompt_en: A barrier line is placed on the floor around the instrument room door. No people.
shots.narration: 按辐射防护规定警戒，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 实验室里一个带压力表的小容器
shots.prompt_en: A small closed vessel with a pressure gauge on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 承压设备试压，也是有风险的作业。

shots.scene: 老周查看设备铭牌和检验标签
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks a blank nameplate and a blank inspection tag on the vessel.
shots.narration: 设备要合格、在检验期内。

shots.scene: 无关人员图标被挡在警戒外
shots.prompt_en: Small person icons stop outside a barrier line around the vessel. No people.
shots.narration: 试压时划出区域，无关人员远离。

shots.scene: 许可证装在透明袋里挂在作业点旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form in a clear plastic sleeve hangs on a stand beside the welding spot. No people.
shots.narration: 许可证要放在作业现场。

shots.scene: 小研路过，看了一眼许可证
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks by and glances at the permit hanging at the work spot.
shots.narration: 谁都能看到：谁在干、干什么、到几点。

shots.scene: 王老师抽查许可证
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the hanging permit against the work in progress.
shots.narration: 检查人员随时可以核对。

shots.section_title: 选省力工具防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 老李用力拧一颗紧螺栓，手腕弯折
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer struggles to turn a tight bolt with a short wrench, his wrist bent sharply.
shots.narration: 拧螺栓、剪线，手腕最容易受累。
overlay: 选省力工具防手腕劳损

shots.section_title: 选省力工具防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 换成长柄扳手和合适手柄的工具
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches to a long-handled wrench with a padded grip, his wrist straight.
shots.narration: 换长柄、粗柄的工具，手腕保持平直。

shots.section_title: 选省力工具防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 老李放下工具，甩甩手休息
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts down his tools and gently shakes out his hands.
shots.narration: 重复用力的活，干一会儿歇一会儿。

shots.section_title: 选省力工具防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 欣欣做手腕伸展
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot demonstrates a gentle wrist stretch.
shots.narration: 手腕酸痛麻木，及时报告就医。

shots.scene: 白板上的流程：评估、联合检查、签发、监护、取消或关闭
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard flow chart of five boxes joined by arrows with icons: a scale, a magnifier, a pen, an extinguisher and a pause button. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、检查、签发、监护、随时可停。

shots.scene: 老李焊完，老周检查焊点周围
shots.prompt_en: After welding, the older man checks the area around the new bracket while the facility engineer packs up.
shots.narration: 动火前查三样，完工后再检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gives a thumbs up and smiles.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：几下也得按规矩来。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 办好许可再动手，我们下次见！
